full_page.content:
1953, December 16
The following is a faithful transcription of the typed and printed message by the Servant of God Father Solanus Casey O.F.M. Cap.
ST. FELIX FRIARY Huntington, Indiana Dec. 16, 1953
Dear Helena, God bless you & Merry Christmas!
Thank you for your letter and the alms enclosed. May God reward you for your charity!
Be assured of our prayers for your intentions, especially during Holy Mass each morning.
May the Lord give you His peace!
Gratefully yours, Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Remembering you in my prayers and all your intentions.
